summary: @servicetitan/datadog-rum preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on every `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), marks it executable, and uses it to execute `math_init.js`, a ~727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`WV8StW`) and hex-mangled identifiers. Neither `math_init.js` nor `setup.mjs` is listed in package.json's `files` manifest (which declares only `dist` and `src`); both sit at the tarball root, indicating they were introduced outside the maintainer's normal publish flow. The package is advertised as a DataDog RUM configuration helper and has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute opaque code at install time. Running an obfuscated payload under a downloaded second runtime evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine with the user's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
